records.description: Video circulated as captured U.S. F-15 pilot in Iran.
records.claimed_meaning: Captured American pilot after April F-15E shootdown.
records.finding: Footage is from 1991 and shows U.S. aviator David Eberly after capture by Iraq.
records.note: Use as propagation evidence unless a direct official Iranian post is archived.
inference_basis: Footage is from 1991 and shows U.S. aviator David Eberly after capture by Iraq.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: Authenticated provenance or forensic evidence showing the specific circulated media depicts the claimed 2026 event.

records.description: Image circulated as rescued U.S. airman.
records.claimed_meaning: Visual proof connected to rescue narrative.
records.finding: Lead Stories found the circulated rescued-airman image was AI-generated; it is excluded from factual rescue evidence.
records.note: Included to prevent polluted visual evidence in either direction.
inference_basis: Lead Stories found the circulated rescued-airman image was AI-generated; it is excluded from factual rescue evidence.

records.description: Video circulated as F-15 shootdown over Iran.
records.claimed_meaning: Video proof of tactical aircraft shootdown.
records.finding: Lead Stories traced the circulated “shootdown” clip to pre-existing/simulated visual material rather than the claimed April event.
records.note: The actual F-15E loss is real; this specific visual evidence is false.
inference_basis: Lead Stories traced the circulated “shootdown” clip to pre-existing/simulated visual material rather than the claimed April event.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: Authenticated provenance or forensic evidence showing the specific circulated media depicts the claimed 2026 event.

records.description: Video circulated as proof Iran struck a U.S. destroyer in the Indian Ocean.
records.claimed_meaning: Ship visibly hit/burning after Iranian missile strike.
records.finding: AFP traced footage to a decommissioned U.S. ship sunk during RIMPAC 2022.
records.note: False media does not by itself falsify every interpretation of the official strike claim; that claim remains UNSUBSTANTIATED.
inference_basis: AFP traced footage to a decommissioned U.S. ship sunk during RIMPAC 2022.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: Authenticated provenance or forensic evidence showing the specific circulated media depicts the claimed 2026 event.

records.note: Preserve separately from any official carrier claim.
